subject: Architecture
title: The Eiffel Tower: From Outrage to Icon
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The Eiffel Tower: From Outrage to Icon.

hook.text: Three hundred artists signed a petition calling the Eiffel Tower a 'metal asparagus' and a disgrace.

buildup.text: Gustave Eiffel built it for the 1889 World's Fair using 18,038 iron pieces and 2.5 million rivets.

discovery.text: It was meant to be temporary — a 20-year permit. Radio antennas on top made it too useful to remove.

twist.text: Eiffel built a secret apartment at the top where he entertained guests like Thomas Edison.

climax.text: The tower that Paris hated became the most visited paid monument in the world.

punchline.text: They wanted it torn down. Now it defines the skyline.

quiz.question: Why wasn't the Eiffel Tower demolished after its permit expired?
options: The French government ran out of demolition funds
Radio antennas on top made it too useful to remove
Public opinion shifted before the permit expired
